Vodafone Egypt - Money transfer fees (Vodafone Cash)
CBE - Rules for Licensing and Registration of Payment System Operators and Payment Service Providers (June 2025)

notes: Fawry publishes no numeric consumer fee for bill payment on its own pages and no tariff schedule is present in the corpus, so no Fawry fee entry exists here. InstaPay fees apply from 1 April 2025; before that date transfers were free for three years.

entries.subject: instapay_transfer_fee_rate
entries.quote: - Transfer Fees: 0.1% from transaction value, minimum EGP 0.50, maximum EGP 20
entries.notes: InstaPay's own tariff page. Egypt Independent (26 Mar 2025) and AfricaNenda SIIPS 2025 report the same 0.1% rate.

entries.subject: instapay_transfer_fee_min
entries.quote: - Transfer Fees: 0.1% from transaction value, minimum EGP 0.50, maximum EGP 20
entries.notes: Same tariff line as the rate. Egypt Independent gives the same floor as 50 piasters.

entries.subject: instapay_transfer_fee_max
entries.quote: - Transfer Fees: 0.1% from transaction value, minimum EGP 0.50, maximum EGP 20
entries.notes: The cap binds from EGP 20,000 upward (0.1% of EGP 20,000 = EGP 20).

entries.subject: instapay_balance_inquiry_fee
entries.display: EGP 0.50 per balance inquiry / mini-statement after the free monthly allowance
entries.quote: - Balance Inquiry and Mini-Statement: EGP 0.50 per transaction, customer can enjoy 10 free transaction monthly
entries.notes: Non-financial service fee, not a transfer fee.

entries.subject: instapay_free_inquiry_allowance
entries.quote: - Balance Inquiry and Mini-Statement: EGP 0.50 per transaction, customer can enjoy 10 free transaction monthly
entries.notes: AfricaNenda SIIPS 2025 reports the same 10 free non-financial transactions per month.

entries.subject: vodafone_cash_wallet_transfer_fee
entries.display: EGP 1 per transfer to another Vodafone Cash wallet
entries.quote: 1LE transfer fees for other Vodafone Cash wallets
entries.notes: No year is given for the 'starting 4th of July' change, so effective_from is null. The Vodafone Money Transfer page states the same EGP 1 fee. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: vodafone_cash_other_wallet_fee_rate
entries.display: 0.5% of value for transfers to wallets other than Vodafone Cash
entries.quote: 0.5% of the transferred value with a minimum of 1LE and up to 10LE
entries.notes: The Money Transfer page describes the same 0.5% fee with a floor of EGP 1 but caps it at EGP 15, not EGP 10; the two Vodafone pages disagree on the cap only. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: vodafone_cash_withdrawal_fee_rate
entries.quote: Withdrawal fees are 1% of the withdrawal amount with a minimum of 3LE
entries.notes: Cash-out at Vodafone/agent points; minimum charge EGP 3. Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: vodafone_cash_withdrawal_fee_min
entries.quote: Withdrawal fees are 1% of the withdrawal amount with a minimum of 3LE
entries.notes: Source is undated; effective_from is the corpus capture date (2026-11-02).

entries.subject: psp_licence_review_fee
entries.display: EGP 30,000 review fee per payment service, capped at EGP 100,000
entries.quote: 5-1-1 Thirty thousand Egyptian pounds for each payment service, up to a maximum of one hundred thousand Egyptian pounds for all services
entries.notes: Section 5 (Fees) of the June 2025 PSO/PSP licensing rules. A separate inspection fee of the same amount is due on licence issuance (5-2-1).

entries.subject: pso_licence_review_fee
entries.display: EGP 100,000 review fee per payment system, capped at EGP 500,000
entries.quote: 5-1-2 One hundred thousand Egyptian pounds for each payment system, up to a maximum of five hundred thousand Egyptian pounds for all systems
entries.notes: Per payment system rather than per service.
